title: substation-telemetry
description: The safety-relevant signal. The curtailment fallback rule is computed from load alone, with no model and no feature store (ADR-0001), which is why load_w is required and nothing else is.

load_w.description: Measured load in watts. Integer: every published quantity in this system is a scaled integer, because a float compared across two engines differs in the last bits (ADR-0004).
